title: ePC: Fast and Deep Predictive Coding in Digital Simulation

split.decision: Official training data stratified 80/20 using train_test_split(random_state=20261030): train 48000, val 12000; sorted original row ids. Each BENCH_SEED runs five replica slots 0..4, actual RNG seeds 5*(BENCH_SEED-1)+slot (mod 2**32); reference [1,2,3].

evidence.finding: Table1 treats architecture,loss and learning paradigm as separate experiment cells; AppendixC.3 explicitly warns against PC settings that reduce to ordinary BP; AppendixE describes inference/weight hyperparameter search.
The selected task is MLP/FashionMNIST/CE with predictive-coding training and134794-parameter baseline structure, not unrestricted classification.
The source distinguishes error inference from detached local weight updates; using the global error energy to update weights is explicitly identified as backprop.
The research predictor has three128-wide GELU hidden layers and a linear CE output.

validation_policy.learned_preprocessing: fit on training only; apply frozen fitted transforms to validation/test
validation_policy.instance_roles: Preserve explicit per-instance observation/training/calibration/causal-feedback roles; no evaluation-target fitting or validation-derived fitted state carried across independent cases.
validation_policy.enforcement: binding prompt and task contract; task-specific replay/guards where available; arbitrary training-data provenance requires source/patch audit
